intro.title: We let you be your true self at work.
intro.lead: Ever thought of a workplace where creative freedom comes first?
intro.body: At FuduGo you get to explore your technical skills in a unique way — where the team is not bound to conventional efforts alone, but empowered to step out of their comfort zone and excel. We believe our people are our assets, and with care and supervision one can reach their career goals. We offer a fair and enjoyable work environment with a real sense of belonging.

testimonial.quote: At FuduGo, we get the freedom of exploring the world of technology and the joy of working in the team, as well as individually. The support is great and the work atmosphere is just what is needed for overall growth.
testimonial.author: Team FuduGo

life.title: Excel professionally and personally.
life.body: Have you ever imagined working in an environment where you can grow in both your craft and your character? At FuduGo, we allow you to be the best version of yourself.

openings.description: Join a team that ships real products — web, mobile, design, and AI — for clients worldwide.

jobs.title: Graphic Designer
jobs.summary: Create brand systems, marketing assets, and visual stories that stay consistent across web and campaigns.
responsibilities: Design brand and marketing assets for digital and print
Collaborate with developers and marketers on campaigns
Maintain visual consistency across client and internal work
requirements: Strong portfolio in branding or digital design
Comfortable with Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite

jobs.title: Junior Web Developer
jobs.summary: Build and maintain modern websites and web apps alongside senior engineers.
responsibilities: Implement UI and features from designs and specs
Write clean, reviewed code in our stack
requirements: 6 months–1 year of web development experience
Basics of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and a modern framework
Willingness to learn and ship in a team environment

jobs.title: Android & iOS Developer
jobs.summary: Help build and ship mobile experiences for iOS and Android.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain mobile app features
Work with designers on polished, usable interfaces
Participate in testing and store release cycles
requirements: 6 months–1 year of mobile development experience
Familiarity with native or cross-platform stacks
Interest in product quality and performance
